title: A Regiment for the Compass
author: Juniper Thackeray
blurb: Kestrel Dunmore, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the census taker asks one question too many, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
